change_scope: Independent no-default-feature auditor, shared unchanged production feature audit, GNU workflow integration, synthetic regressions and contributor documentation. No runtime, routing, transport, dependency, version or shipping-default changes.
producer_contract: begin observes the clean exact checkout, lock/config files, pinned standalone Rust/Perl SDK, compiler/wrapper identities, portable flags, builder record and original public workflow/run context.

begin requires distinct unused absolute report paths and an absent release output tree. Every finished Cargo compiler-artifact must be newly built (fresh:false). The collector never deletes caches or builds a product.

finish recomputes the existing production feature/supplier audit, matches its exact canonical report and actual Cargo executable, then inspects target ELF, GLIBC <=2.28 and absent host OpenSSL/search-path dependencies.

finish rechecks observed inputs and retains an exact binary/provenance pair in a new mode 0700 directory, binary mode 0755 and report mode 0600. Owned-inode cleanup preserves unowned collisions and replacements.
Unknown build overrides, local/unreviewed contexts, unsupported targets, cached artifacts, drift and invalid owned reports fail closed. Input, environment, capture and output limits remain explicit.
